response.description:
QoS update with cool
access enabled on Premium and Ultra service levels improves how Azure
NetApp Files balances performance and cost for mixed hot and cool workloads.
Throughput automatically adjusts as data moves to cool storage, maintaining hot‑tier
performance while enabling customers to benefit from cool access at
scale. This enhancement continuously optimizes pool and
volume throughput as cool access patterns change, delivering a
seamless experience without manual tuning.  Learn more:
 What's
     new in Azure NetApp Files

     NetApp Files storage with cool access

     levels for Azure NetApp Files   Manage
Azure NetApp Files storage with cool access
response.title: Public Preview: Azure NetApp Files storage with cool access enhancement
